transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I've called us together to discuss the first-year composition program's proposal to pilot an AI writing-feedback platform in two sections next term. As I understand it, the platform can generate comments on student drafts and be configured for different levels of instructor control. Before I can make a decision on whether this pilot may proceed and under what conditions, I'd like to hear from both the writing program and the privacy office regarding any instructional or data-handling requirements we should be aware of. Could we start with the writing program's perspective on the instructional considerations?
